questions.q: A related list is best described as which relationship?
options: The reverse direction of a reference field — records on another table that point back at the open record
A copy of the current record's own fields, duplicated at the bottom of the form
A list of every table in the instance
A permanent merge of two tables into one
questions.explain: A related list queries another table for records whose reference field points back at the record you have open.

questions.q: Where does the data shown in a related list actually live?
options: On the other table being queried, not on the record whose form you're viewing
Copied directly onto the open record's own fields
Nowhere — related lists are purely cosmetic and show no real data
In the sys_dictionary table only
questions.explain: Related lists are live query results from another table — the Incident record itself doesn't store that data.

questions.q: What does an Incident's "Affected CIs" related list show?
options: Configuration items from the CMDB that this incident impacts
Every incident ever logged on the instance
A list of all users who can view the incident
The incident's own field history
questions.explain: Affected CIs surfaces CMDB records linked to this incident, not data stored on the Incident table itself.

questions.q: Why are related lists kept visually separate, below a form's main fields?
options: Because they describe records on other tables, not more fields on the open record
Because ServiceNow cannot render them inside the form fields area at all
Because related lists are only visible to administrators
Because they replace the need for a List Layout configuration
questions.explain: The form's fields describe the one open record; related lists describe other records elsewhere that reference it.

questions.q: How are related lists controlled per form?
options: Through a "Configure > Related Lists" picker that adds, removes, or reorders which relationships show
They are hard-coded per table and cannot be changed
Only Bill Green's support team can configure them
By editing the sys_dictionary entry for the Caller field
questions.explain: Related lists follow the same configurable philosophy as Form Layout and List Layout — admins choose what shows.
